bullets.text: A road cave-in on Velachery Main Road near Phoenix Marketcity halted traffic, and the office should monitor Metrowater repairs.
Tiruvallur Collector S. Kavitha declared a school holiday for Monday due to heavy rain forecasts, and the team should track weather updates.
Cyclone Murasu is moving towards south Andhra Pradesh with an orange alert for Chennai and Thiruvallur, requiring strict district vigilance.
Spot-billed pelicans resting on high-voltage towers in Pallikaranai marshland are dying from electrocution, and the office must coordinate safety fixes.
The Tamil Nadu Traders Federation youth wing held an anti-drug marathon in Besant Nagar, and the local team should support similar initiatives.
India data centre capacity may reach 2 GW in 2026 driven by AI demand, and the minister should watch for state expansion opportunities.
Global Startup Summit 2026 is scheduled for November 14 at Holiday Inn Chennai OMR IT Expressway, and the office should prepare for engagement.
